title: Q-DISCLOSE-seed-slim: the seed carries only what a new instance needs to deploy and run
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** Q-DISCLOSE-check; `seed/agents/AGENTS.md` is 140 KB and 91 lines carry a dated owner quote, all loaded by every new instance
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation disclosure --seed
**Status:** closed

`seed/agents/AGENTS.md` becomes the operating agreement (load order, the interrupt gate, claims and handoff, item format, review, plussing, changing the rules) and points at the generated `seed/SYSTEM.md` rules index, which keeps one line and one enforcement path per rule. The long-form rule narrative stays in the platform and in the private specification. `coldstart --check` and `scripts/system.py --check` compare the seed against the index, not against the narrative, and still fail on a rule with no enforcement in the kit.

**Prediction:** disclosure.seed_rule_narratives <= 0 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** rewriting git history (the ruleset refuses force pushes); changing the platform's agents/AGENTS.md, which every repository fetches by public URL (AGENT-BOOTSTRAP-1); moving the company papers already in ultrastable/ops admin/. Removing a rule's enforcement from the kit.

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation disclosure --seed` exits 0 on main. It fails today: the command does not exist.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T18:22:17Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
